text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes~, sorry to keep you waiting. 
Fuji-san, what did you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for calling you out. The truth is, 
I'd like you to take a look at the state 
of the Ritto Dormitory's nukadoko.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Let's see here...? Oh, dear me...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There was a report from a dorm student 
this morning. She said when she tried to 
eat the pickles, they tasted strange.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They certainly have spoiled, haven't they. 
...Perhaps the weather is to blame. It's 
been quite unstable lately, after all...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I searched online to see if there was 
anything we could do, and even had a 
greengrocer look at it. However, I 
couldn't get any good advice.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san. In that case, would it be all 
right if I took charge of it? Please let 
me try and see if I can nurse it back to 
health.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's something passed down through 
generations in the dorm, after all. I'd 
like to do everything in my power to help.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Having you on board is so 
reassuring! I'll gladly rely on you, 
Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
First, let's discard the spoiled parts, 
shall we? ...Heave-ho.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes... it looks like there's still a tiny 
bit of vitality left toward the bottom, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll add fresh rice bran right away and 
bring back its freshness~. I'm going to 
use fresh raw bran, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Acute-chan, you have bread today too? 
Want to eat up on the rooftop together?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, thank you for the invite. However, 
I have some business I cannot miss, you 
see. I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
...Acute-chan seems pretty busy lately, 
huh. Every recess recently, she heads off 
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I saw her walking all 
over the place with a thermometer the 
other day. What was she doing, I 
wonder...?

As I was walking down the stairs, out of 
nowhere, I overheard a horse girl 
muttering to herself.

There's a good child~. Cheer up now, 
okay~?

Curious, I peeked in... And found Wonder 
Acute talking to some kind of container 
with a piece of bread in one hand.
choice_data_list: What are you doing in a place like this?
What are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Tending to the nukadoko, of course.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...And that's the story. Just now, I was 
speaking to it and giving it some 
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This spot, you see, is the best 
environment in the entire academy at this 
hour.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I searched all over the place for an 
environment where the nukadoko could rest 
comfortably, but—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The PE storage room had poor ventilation 
and high humidity, you see. It looked like 
it was suffocating.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, the infirmary had too 
much sun, it felt like it'd wilt right 
away...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And so, I finally found this spot. I can 
practically hear it saying, 'Ah, this 
feels so good~.'

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I just did everything I could, is all. 
Because I really wanted this pickling bed 
to bounce back.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—It's my goal, you see. Just like this 
pickling bed, I want to...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Soothing our tiredness after training. And 
whenever we feel frustrated, masking the 
taste of our tears with its sourness.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This pickling bed has always been there, 
gently watching over us with kindness. 
Ever since I first entered the Ritto 
Dorm...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...I want to become an umamusume like that 
too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So as long as there's still hope, I won't 
give up. I'll just give it all the care I 
have.
choice_data_list: Then we can't let it end here.
Then we can't let it end here, can we?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So as long as there's still hope, I won't 
give up. I'll just give it all the care I 
have.
choice_data_list: Then we can't let it end here.
Then we can't let it end here, can we?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The Ritto Dorm needs it, after all. 
From now on, on and on into the future.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Acute. I found a girl who wants 
to help take care of the pickling bed. 
Would you let us lend a hand?

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, please let me help too! I don't 
know much about pickling beds, but... 
well, I'm a Ritto Dorm resident too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You've been diligently moving the pickling 
bed around every break, right? In that 
case, how about we take turns managing it 
together?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that'd be a huge help. Don't mind 
if I take you up on that. Well then, let 
me teach you the tricks to caring for it~.

Following that, with dedicated care from 
Wonder Acute and the others, the Ritto 
Dorm's pickling bed was successfully 
revived.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that's a big help. Well then, shall 
we talk to the pickling bed together?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: There's a good one~. Cheer up now~.
choice_data_list: There's a good one~ Cheer up now~

text_block_list.text:
Following that, with Wonder Acute's 
affectionate care, the Ritto Dorm's 
pickling bed was successfully revived.
